verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a first-party Scheduling Links booking feature. Its priority settings apply per scheduling link, which implies several configurable link types. Nothing in the evidence documents per-link durations, locations, custom intake questions, or confirmation/approval rules. Missing for 10: documented per-event-type durations, location settings, custom booking questions, confirmation/approval rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer multiple event types with their own durations, locations, custom questions, and confirmation rules

citations.quote: Scheduling Links enable you to send links to you and your team's availability, allowing others to book time across one, or many, calendars.
Share your availability using smart meeting controls.
Set the priority level for your Habits, Tasks, Smart Meetings, Scheduling Links, and even Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar events from Critical (P1) to Low priority (P4)
